source.wylie: gnyis pa ni, dngos po rang bzhin gyis grub pa med par 'dod pa'i phyogs la, kun gzhi sogs khas ma blangs kyang las 'bras kyi 'brel pa 'thad tshul ji ltar yin zhe na
source.english: Here is the second point [of still another discussion]. One may ask the following: Those who believe that entities have no natural existence [meaning the Madhyamika Prasangika (or Consequence) School] do not accept the concepts of a foundation consciousness and the like; how then is it that they can still assert that all the workings of karma and its consequences are totally right and proper?
